rules.statement: An isolated transaction does not constitute a trade or business for the purposes of income tax.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is well settled that an isolated trading transaction of a simple character outside a man's ordinary business does not amount to the carrying on of a trade within the meaning of the section so as to render the profits of the transaction liable to taxation. They are casual profits which do not form part of his regular income."

meta.parties: Commissioner of Income Tax v. De Zoysa
